profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Udemy | Agentic Engineering | Bringing solo-founder leverage to enterprise-scale platforms.
profile.summary:
Im Luke Smith, a fullstack software engineer who brings solo-founder leverage to enterprise platforms. I use agentic engineering to move fast and own problems end to end, the way I had to as a founder. 

Im the primary engineer on an agentic migration initiative at Udemy, architecting the verification and automation systems that made a legacy-to-modern platform rebuild safe to ship, including agentic testing infrastructure built on Claudes agent tooling. 

Previously, I founded Syncly, a Solana-native tax platform that transformed raw on-chain data into clear, human-readable tax reports. I designed and deployed its Python FastAPI backend to consolidate data from multiple Solana APIs, enhance pricing accuracy, and power real-time tax insights, handling 10K+ transactions in its MVP phase. 

Before that, I worked in Developer Relations at Marginfi, where I helped onboard developers to their SDK through technical content, videos, and documentation. I also migrated their public site from Markdown to Sanity CMS and contributed to ecosystem launches that improved developer adoption by 30%. 

At John Deere, I served as a Software Engineering Intern, where I helped refactor legacy systems using Java, built PostgreSQL-backed services, and implemented AWS automation that improved platform reliability across engineering teams. 

I focus on agentic engineering, great developer experience, and building infrastructure thats easy to use.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Core engineer on Udemy's interactive coding-lab platform, used by millions of learners. Primary engineer on an agentic migration initiative, architecting the verification and automation systems that made a legacy-to-modern platform rebuild safe to ship.

1. Architected the agentic verification system behind a legacy-to-modern platform migration, building on Claude's agent tooling to track 66 feature combinations and catch regressions before launch.
2. Built an agentic development harness that ran the full test environment without live infrastructure, enabling engineers to verify close to 85 product scenarios and eliminating manual release checks.
3. Designed the access and quota system gating premium features, backed by 55+ automated tests, directly shaping the free-to-paid upgrade experience.
4. Fixed a critical production bug causing 44,000+ error events, restoring reliability for learners using the platform's core workspace feature.
5. Designed 21 new analytics events for a content-creation feature, giving product teams the data to measure adoption and impact.
6. Built AI-agent orchestration systems, including smart request routing to cut cost and latency, plus a shared memory layer enabling multiple AI agents to collaborate safely.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Next.js · React.js · GraphQL · Kotlin · Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) · A/B Testing · Product-Led Growth · Agile Development

positions.title: Founder & Fullstack Engineer
positions.description:
Founded and shipped Syncly, a Solana-native tax platform streamlining blockchain transaction reporting for traders and developers.
• Built fullstack product with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and real-time Solana API integrations
• Designed backend pipelines and frontend dashboards optimized for UX clarity and modular growth
• Handled over 10K+ transactions in MVP phase, prioritizing performance, scalability, and usability
• Led product development, technical architecture, and early go-to-market planning
positions.insights: Skills: FastAPI · PostgreSQL · Next.js · Docker · Deployment & DevOps · API Development · Solana

positions.title: Developer Relations Intern
positions.description:
- Onboarded early-stage founders and developers to Marginfi’s SDK through 1:1 technical support and community engagement. Helped launch multiple startups within the Marginfi ecosystem.
- Created video content and technical guides with partner teams to boost awareness and accelerate developer adoption.
- Acted as the main point of contact for developer support. Relayed feedback and issues to engineering and leadership to improve product direction.
- Refactored Marginfi’s documentation site from markdown to Sanity CMS, enabling non-technical teammates to publish updates and improving content velocity.
positions.insights: Skills: Content Strategy · JavaScript · Web3 · Solana · Developer Relations · SDK Documentation · TypeScript · GitHub · Sanity CMS · Rust

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
- Led full stack development of a blockchain-integrated anti-fraud platform using React, Node.js, Next.js, and MongoDB, delivering a secure and scalable MVP.
- Championed Agile methodologies across a small, fast-moving team, resulting in consistent sprint velocity and on-time delivery of feature milestones.
- Guided the team through strategic pivots and technical roadblocks, helping maintain momentum and morale during early-stage volatility.
- Oversaw the entire product lifecycle from ideation to deployment, aligning engineering deliverables with evolving business goals and user needs.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Product Strategy · Graphic Design Principles · Next.js · Client Work · Clerk · UX Design · Backend Engineering · GitHub · React / Next.js · MongoDB · Solana · Vercel · Start-up Leadership

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Designed, developed, tested, and deployed a full stack internal tool using Java and Next.js that streamlined a multistep data reprocessing workflow into three simple steps, improving developer efficiency.
- Migrated legacy code from 10+ repositories (Scala, Go) into Java, implementing unit and integration tests with JUnit and Mockito to ensure functionality and maintainability.
- Automated CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, integrating AWS Secrets Manager for secure environment variable management and deploying to AWS ECS.
- Participated in Agile development ceremonies including daily standups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and stakeholder meetings to align technical implementation with business requirements.
- Delivered the project ahead of schedule in under 3 months, fully deployed and used by Deere’s internal data teams.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Graphic Design Principles · PostgreSQL · Next.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Backend Engineering · GitHub · Java Spring · Java · Java API · Amazon ECS · AWS Secrets Manager · Docker · React / Next.js · GitHub Actions · Terraform · Axios · JUnit · Mockito

projects.title: Syncly – Solana Tax API
projects.description: Founder of Syncly, a blockchain tax insights API that processes and enriches Solana wallet data. Built with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Stripe, and deployed via Vercel. Gained 5K+ impressions through X/LinkedIn promotion and early user traction.
